name: Capilano University
description: Capilano University is a teaching-focused public university based in North Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, nestled in a natural forested setting on the slopes of the North Shore Mountains. The University's reputation rests on its smaller class sizes of 25-35 students which provide for more personalized teaching and learning.  In having aligned its program offerings with the BC Skills for Jobs Blueprint to ensure that students are career-ready for the most in-demand jobs when they graduate. Timestamps Updated
